note: Starting points, not measured results. The style goes in speech_metadata.style on 3.8 and in ### PERFORMANCE on 3.1 and 2.5; keep it byte-identical across a project. Words per minute are rules of thumb until three chunks calibrate the voice. Audition every voice before a client job.
bangla_accent: On 3.8 the accent belongs in the voice, not in the style: run `design` once with the preset's design_prompt and language bn-BD, audition three takes, and pin the winner with `design keep`; the prebuilt voice stays as the fallback. On 3.1 and 2.5 the director_accent line is added to the performance block.
